verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 98.2 (-3.8% in a day) and momentum is 39: prices are falling. 84s cost 900, 85s 2,400 and 86s 5,000. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-10T07:30:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Matthias Ginter 86 UEFA Conference League RTTK after its 40% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 18,250 coins. Now 18,250. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 39.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 6 of 12 so far, averaging +5.4% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-12T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 900 (1.08 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,400 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,000 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,000 (1.27 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,500 (1.39 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Rodrigo Muniz and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Rodrigo Muniz 76 Rare -53.1%; Marcus Edwards 75 Rare -45.7%; Kike Salas 76 Rare -44.2%; Tolu Arokodare 75 Rare -43.9%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
